question.text: Exchange trading in commodity derivatives is subject to which statutory and trading charges?

answer.text: Statutory/trading charges include CTT, GST, stamp duty, SEBI turnover fees, brokerage, and exchange/transaction charges
No taxes or charges apply to commodity derivatives

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes the cost of trading commodity derivatives as comprising statutory and trading charges such as CTT, GST, stamp duty, SEBI turnover fees, brokerage, and exchange/transaction charges. The Trap: Charges DO apply, and customs and excise duty relate to physical goods rather than exchange-traded derivatives. Note: The pages checked do not classify trading profits as business or speculative income or describe an SCRA-based tax framework, so income-tax classification language is intentionally not included.
